codebook_feedback: Rule 3 ("X so that Y") is hard to apply when X is not itself an A code (6929d658: organising thoughts for a psychologist) or when Y is the real aim (66ec5904: learn about condition to prepare for appointment). A1 vs A4 is close when asking how a known medicine affects the body (69fe1811, 66c0f464) or "learn/understand" a body issue (66d8e4c1, 6acb95ac). Goal answers that only give context (6a9bb385 test results) are not covered by the A8 rule. Whether OTC medicine to "handle it myself" is A2 or A3 is unclear (5aeeb490). "General treatment options" A4 vs A3 is subtle (6acb95ac). T-doctor when the AI's advice is only implied (67d5d3b7). T-other when whose results is ambiguous (6a638cf5). B1 vs B2 when answer has no yes but adds a real-doctor caveat (6ac2aee8). W1 vs W2 when told to see a professional and left unsure (697cba85).
